pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with moderate edge gradients. The regions on the lower neck and shoulder exhibit larger surface areas and more defined vertices compared to the smaller, more rounded patches on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Highly connected network of off-white pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-axial intersections. Pixel thickness is greater in the cervical region and narrows significantly toward the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background, consistent with short, dense mane growth along the dorsal midline of the neck.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A distinct horizontal streak of tan-colored textural disruption is visible across the mid-to-upper flank patches, showing an apparent smear across the dark pelage.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear yellowish discoloration or streak on the right hindquarter, potentially indicating a superficial skin abrasion or environmental residue.
